_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 34, Example Problem 16: Partial Displaced Left-Turn Intersection (Exhibits 34-139 through 34-145, 269_Ch34_02c.xhtml). Speedway Blvd (E-W) at Campbell Ave (N-S); E-W left turns displaced 350 ft upstream of the main intersection; fully-actuated signals, PHF = 0.92, background cycle C = 65 s. This fixture reproduces the Step 5 offset computation (Equations 23-63 through 23-68: TD_DLT = 350 ft, S_f,DLT = 35 mi/h -> TT_DLT = 6.8 s; LAG_TH = 52 s; O_SUPP = 45.2 s; the example rounds TT_DLT to 7 s and reports 45 s) and the Step 9/10 volume-weighted control-delay aggregation (Equation 23-69: sum of the Exhibit 34-145 flow*delay products = 159,675, sum of O-D demands = 5,594, ETT_DLT = 28.5 s/veh, LOS C from the Chapter 19 thresholds). The per-junction (flow, delay) cells are the Exhibit 34-145 values.
